publication.submitted_child_yaml:
steps:
- id: source
  run: exo-arb assign --instance source_evidence --type source_evidence --drop-ack
    true
  retry_policy:
    limit: 2
    interval_sec: 1
- id: counter
  run: exo-arb assign --instance counter_evidence --type counter_evidence
  retry_policy:
    limit: 2
    interval_sec: 1
- id: join_evidence
  depends:
  - source
  - counter
  run: exo-arb join --branches source_evidence,counter_evidence
- id: synthesize_r1
  depends: join_evidence
  run: exo-arb synthesize --revision r1 --resolved false
- id: quality_r1
  depends: synthesize_r1
  run: exo-arb quality --revision r1
  output: VERDICT_R1
  retry_policy:
    limit: 2
    interval_sec: 1
- id: route_r1
  depends: quality_r1
  action: router.route
  with:
    value: ${VERDICT_R1}
    routes:
      accepted:
      - accept_r1
      - release_r1
      rejected:
      - repair_r2
      - quality_r2
      - route_r2
- id: accept_r1
  run: exo-arb accept --revision r1
  retry_policy:
    limit: 2
    interval_sec: 1
- id: release_r1
  depends: accept_r1
  run: exo-arb release --revision r1
  retry_policy:
    limit: 2
    interval_sec: 1
- id: repair_r2
  run: exo-arb repair --from r1 --to r2 --resolved input
- id: quality_r2
  depends: repair_r2
  run: exo-arb quality --revision r2
  output: VERDICT_R2
  retry_policy:
    limit: 2
    interval_sec: 1
- id: route_r2
  depends: quality_r2
  action: router.route
  with:
    value: ${VERDICT_R2}
    routes:
      accepted:
      - release_r2
      rejected:
      - repair_r3
      - quality_r3
      - route_r3
- id: release_r2
  run: exo-arb release --revision r2
  retry_policy:
    limit: 2
    interval_sec: 1
- id: repair_r3
  run: exo-arb repair --from r2 --to r3 --resolved input
- id: quality_r3
  depends: repair_r3
  run: exo-arb quality --revision r3
  output: VERDICT_R3
  retry_policy:
    limit: 2
    interval_sec: 1
- id: route_r3
  depends: quality_r3
  action: router.route
  with:
    value: ${VERDICT_R3}
    routes:
      accepted:
      - accept_r3
      - release_r3
      rejected:
      - director_wait
      - abort_after_wait
- id: accept_r3
  run: exo-arb accept --revision r3
  retry_policy:
    limit: 2
    interval_sec: 1
- id: release_r3
  depends: accept_r3
  run: exo-arb release --revision r3
  retry_policy:
    limit: 2
    interval_sec: 1
- id: director_wait
  action: human.task
  with:
    prompt: Repairs exhausted; authorize abort of the exact current revision
    form:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      properties:
        decision:
          type: string
          enum:
          - abort
        revision:
          type: string
          enum:
          - r3
      required:
      - decision
      - revision
- id: abort_after_wait
  depends: director_wait
  run: exo-arb abort --revision r3

      - abort_after_wait
- id: accept_r3
  run: exo-arb accept --revision r3
  retry_policy:
    limit: 2
    interval_sec: 1
- id: release_r3
  depends: accept_r3
  run: exo-arb release --revision r3
  retry_policy:
    limit: 2
    interval_sec: 1
- id: director_wait
  action: human.task
  with:
    prompt: Repairs exhausted; authorize abort of the exact current revision
    form:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      properties:
        decision:
          type: string
          enum:
          - abort
        revision:
          type: string
          enum:
          - r3
      required:
      - decision
      - revision
- id: abort_after_wait
  depends: director_wait
  run: exo-arb abort --revision r3
